{{Short description|American chemist and businessman}}
'''Jai P. Nagarkatti''' (February 18, 1947, in [[Hyderabad, India]] – November 13, 2010, in [[Saint Louis, Missouri]]) was an American [[chemist]] and businessman who served as the chairman, chief operating officer, CEO, and president of [[Sigma Aldrich]].<ref>[http://www.stltoday.com/business/article_46d399bc-61e2-521a-9ff8-b7048bf6ab3b.html Jai Nagarkatti, Sigma-Aldrich CEO, dies at 63], by Jim Doyle, [[St. Louis Post-Dispatch]], November 16, 2010, retrieved January 22, 2011</ref>

Nagarkatti earned a master's degree in organic chemistry from [[Osmania University]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Daues |first=Jessica |date=2010-11-16 |title=Trustee Jai P. Nagarkatti, 63 |url=https://source.washu.edu/2010/11/trustee-jai-p-nagarkatti-63/ |access-date= |website=The Source |language=en-US}}</ref>  Nagarkatti joined Sigma-Aldrich in 1976, after graduating from [[Texas A&M University–Commerce]],<ref>"Remembering Dr. Jai P. Nagarkatti (1947–2010)", ''[[Aldrichimica Acta]]'', vol. 43, no. 3 (2010), p. 63, by Dr. Sharbil J. Firsan</ref> and worked there for the rest of his career. In 2004, he became company president and [[chief operating officer]]; in 2005 he joined the board of directors, followed by becoming CEO in 2006 and chairman of the board in 2009.<ref>[http://investor.sigmaaldrich.com/releasedetail.cfm?ReleaseID=530331 Sigma-Aldrich Corporation Announces Death of Chairman and CEO; Election of New CEO and Chairman; Conference Call Scheduled for 10:00a.m. (Central Time) on November 15, 2010] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101119050430/http://investor.sigmaaldrich.com/releasedetail.cfm?ReleaseID=530331 |date=November 19, 2010 }}, [[Sigma-Aldrich]], November 14, 2010, retrieved January 22, 2011</ref> 

In 2004, he also finished the advanced Management Program at [[Harvard Business School]].<ref name=":0" /> In 2007, he was elected to the Board of Trustees at [[Washington University in St. Louis]].<ref name=":0" />  He also served on the Board for the [[Missouri Botanical Garden]] and the [[Saint Louis Science Center]].<ref name=":0" />

The Reading Garden at Samuel C. Sachs Branch of [[St. Louis County Library]] in [[Chesterfield, Missouri|Chesterfield, MO]] which opened in 2015 was named “Jai Nagarkatti Monsanto Company Reading Garden”, in honor of Mr. Nagarkatti.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.slcl.org/content/samuel-c-sachs-branch|title=Samuel C. Sachs Branch {{!}} St. Louis County Library|website=www.slcl.org|language=en|access-date=2018-11-13}}</ref>
